items.text: The spring market is on, and every stall wants paying. Add the prices up one at a time: $4 and $6 make $10.

items.prompt: Plums cost $7 and honey costs $5. How many dollars for both?
You hand over $20 for that $12 basket. How many dollars come back?
A stall takes 50% off an $18 hat. What's 50% of 18?
items.explain: 50% is a half, and half of 18 is 9.
10% is a tenth, and a tenth of 40 is 4.

items.text: The park tournament has boards out on the grass. Rosa has set three warm-ups and one last game. No chess needed: each board says how its piece moves.

items.prompt: A rook slides straight along a row or a column. Collect both stars in 2 moves.
items.explain: Up the a column, then along the top row.

items.prompt: A bishop slides on the diagonals. Collect both stars in 2 moves.
items.explain: Out along one diagonal to g5, then back up the other to d8.

items.prompt: A knight jumps in an L: two squares one way, one to the side. Collect both stars in 2 moves.
items.explain: An L to f3, then another L to g5.

items.prompt: The last game. The black king's own pawns box him in. Slide your rook to the top row for checkmate.
items.explain: Rook to a8 attacks along the whole top row, and the king has nowhere to step.

items.text: Harvest time, and I'm gathering the last of the flowers. I follow steps, one at a time, in order. Your steps get me there.

items.prompt: Three steps along the row. I start as soon as the last one is in.
This flower is behind me. Two steps.
items.explain: Left, left. I walk whichever way the blocks say.

items.prompt: The last one is up a row. Build the steps.
items.explain: Three right and one up. Up first works too: there's more than one way.

items.say: Snow on the hills, lights strung up. Come and sit by the lanterns with me.
text: Breathe in for 4, then out slowly for 8.
Picture a lantern brightening as you breathe in, and softening as you breathe out.
If 8 feels long, breathe out as slowly as is comfortable.
